plugins.name: engineering-rules
plugins.description: The engineering law and working method as one skill and nine route sub-commands. The always-on law, the run discipline and the delegation authorization load with the skill; the remaining sections are read only when the phase calls for them. Invoke it bare to be walked through the routes, or pick one outright with /engineering-rules:quick, :full, :shape, :walkthrough, :audit, :triage, :skill, :design or :log; an agentless first word keeps the whole task in the main chat. Hooks enforce the bans at the tool boundary; the helper shapes run on Claude Code's own agent types, briefed by the skill, all on the session's model.
